def.en: The release of a mature egg from an ovary, usually once in each menstrual cycle, about two weeks before the next period.
def.hg: Ovary se ek mature egg ka release hona, jo usually har menstrual cycle mein ek baar, agle period se lagbhag do hafte pehle hota hai.

def.en: The joining of a sperm and an egg, usually in a fallopian tube, to form a single cell that can develop into an embryo.
def.hg: Sperm aur egg ka milna, jo usually fallopian tube mein hota hai, aur jisse ek aisi single cell banti hai jo embryo mein develop ho sakti hai.

def.en: The stage, about a week after fertilisation, when the developing embryo attaches to the lining of the uterus and pregnancy is established.
def.hg: Fertilisation ke lagbhag ek hafte baad ka woh stage jab develop ho raha embryo uterus ki lining se attach ho jaata hai aur pregnancy establish hoti hai.

def.en: The name for the developing baby during roughly the first two months after fertilisation, when the main organs are forming. Later it is called a fetus.
def.hg: Fertilisation ke baad ke lagbhag pehle do mahinon mein develop ho rahe baby ka naam, jab main organs ban rahe hote hain. Baad mein isse fetus kaha jaata hai.

def.en: A temporary organ attached to the uterus wall that supplies the baby with oxygen and nutrients and removes waste through the umbilical cord.
def.hg: Uterus ki wall se juda ek temporary organ jo umbilical cord ke through baby tak oxygen aur nutrients pahunchata hai aur waste hatata hai.

def.en: One of the three stages of pregnancy, each about three months long, used to describe how the pregnancy and the baby are progressing.
def.hg: Pregnancy ke teen stages mein se ek, har ek lagbhag teen mahine ka, jisse bataya jaata hai ki pregnancy aur baby ka development kahan tak pahuncha hai.

def.en: Human chorionic gonadotropin, a hormone made after implantation. Home pregnancy tests detect it in urine and clinics can measure it in blood.
def.hg: Human chorionic gonadotropin, ek hormone jo implantation ke baad banta hai. Home pregnancy tests isse urine mein detect karte hain aur clinics isse blood mein measure kar sakte hain.

def.en: Regular health check-ups during pregnancy that monitor the pregnant person and the baby and detect problems early.
def.hg: Pregnancy ke dauraan hone wale regular health check-ups, jo pregnant person aur baby ko monitor karte hain aur problems ko jaldi pakad lete hain.

def.en: The natural loss of a pregnancy in its early or middle months. It is common and is usually caused by chance problems in the embryo.
def.hg: Shuruaati ya beech ke mahinon mein pregnancy ka apne aap khatam ho jaana. Yeh common hai aur iski wajah usually embryo mein chance se hui problem hoti hai.

def.en: A pregnancy that implants outside the uterus, usually in a fallopian tube. It cannot continue and needs urgent medical treatment.
def.hg: Aisi pregnancy jo uterus ke bahar, usually fallopian tube mein, implant ho jaati hai. Yeh continue nahi ho sakti aur isme urgent medical treatment zaroori hai.

def.en: A medical condition defined as not achieving pregnancy after twelve months or more of regular unprotected intercourse. It can involve any partner.
def.hg: Ek medical condition, jiski definition hai baarah mahine ya usse zyada regular unprotected intercourse ke baad bhi pregnancy na hona. Iski wajah kisi bhi partner mein ho sakti hai.

def.en: The legal and medical term in India for abortion carried out by a qualified doctor at an approved facility under the MTP Act.
def.hg: India mein us abortion ke liye legal aur medical term jo MTP Act ke under qualified doctor dwara approved facility par kiya jaata hai.
